findings: Normal versus unrelated reasoning has identical PC in all16 and one SA loss; no demonstrated correct-reasoning PC advantage.
Normal versus no injection has PC+0.125 with3 wins12 ties1 loss; SA is identical and Joint improves5 to6. This limited branch benefit does not identify correct reasoning as its source.
Normal versus fixed train-mean Q update improves SA and PC by0.125 and Joint4 to6, with PC3 wins12 ties1 loss. Unrelated reasoning retains the same normal PC values, including the three improvements.

Normal versus full train-mean C has PC-0.0625 (1 win13 ties2 losses), SA+0.0625 and Joint5 to6. Normal improves VP010 PC, loses VP017/027 PC, and improves VP025 SA; no net PC benefit over fixed fullC.
The mean-update and mean-C controls fix both CFG conditions in different ways; unrelated changes only positive reasoning. All five declared16 controls are now complete.
Normal versus anchor-only adds PC+0.0625(2wins13ties1loss; +VP004/015,-VP027), SA+0.0625(onlyVP010), and Joint5 to6. Correct and unrelated PC remain identical in every case.

Anchor-only versus no injection adds PC+0.0625(2wins13ties1loss; +VP002/010,-VP015) and loses SA0.0625(onlyVP010); Joint stays5. The learned correction repairs some anchor-induced losses, adds VP004 PC, and loses VP027 PC.
All declared R7 evaluation is complete. Full40 PC3.425 remains below R1-4003.625; no adoption or training extension. Fixed full-meanC16 PC3.750 still exceeds normal3.6875.
